subject: Genetics
title: Forensic Genealogy Controversy
description: A tiny lesson with a big payoff: Forensic Genealogy Controversy.

hook.text: The Golden State Killer was caught in 2018 using his relatives' DNA from GEDmatch. He never submitted his own DNA.

buildup.text: Police uploaded crime-scene DNA to public genealogy databases.

discovery.text: Forensic genealogy has solved over 500 cold cases.

twist.text: Your relative's DNA choice exposes you.

climax.text: The debate: solving murders vs. genetic surveillance.

punchline.text: Your cousin's spit kit could solve a murder—or expose you.

quiz.question: How was the Golden State Killer identified?
options: His own DNA in a database
A relative's DNA in a public genealogy database
